name: OnlyFlix Local
description: Pure-local OnlyFlix build for Nuvio. All four sources resolve on the Android device. No Vercel resolver or self-hosted cloud fallback is used.

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · CDNM
scrapers.description: Pure local: device-side TMDB→IMDb lookup, PlayerJS #2 decoding and IP-bound HLS generation.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · VidAPI
scrapers.description: Pure local: device directly calls the current VAPlayer/VidAPI upstream and returns direct HLS.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · NontonGo
scrapers.description: Pure local: device parses multisourcesoap and probes candidate Soap2 nodes directly, with no cloud fallback.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · VidFast
scrapers.description: Pure local: device tries the native VidFast token+enc/dec protocol, then the local VAPlayer source=vidfast path. No cloud fallback.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local
